image_description: A white minibus (likely a Mercedes-Benz Sprinter or similar model) is parked in a lot, angled towards the left. It features a high roof, a row of side windows, and red/black graphics on the side. In the foreground, the hood and headlight of a red car are visible. In the background, there are other vehicles (a white van and a red/white van) and green trees.
